articles.summary: In an article entitled "4 Considerations When Buying or Building Legal Technology," Legaltech news reports on Burford's recent webinar about unlocking generative AI in legal technology, moderated by Vice Chair David Perla. The article touches on major themes of the webinar, such as the evolution of legal roles given the rise of AI and whether to build or buy legal tech software.
articles.title: Legaltech news reports on Burford's AI and legal tech webinar

articles.summary: Burford CFO Jordan Licht is a guest on the GrowCFO Show podcast. As described on the program's website: "The core focus of the discussion centers around Burford Capital and the unique world of litigation finance. Jordan provides an overview of how Burford invests in commercial litigation cases…and explains Burford’s thorough underwriting process, the challenges of estimating case durations, and the benefits their capital and expertise can provide to clients. The conversation also touches on Burford’s global presence, their approach to building a non-law firm culture, and the complexities of funding and managing the company’s own capital requirements."
articles.title: Jordan Licht on the GrowCFO Show podcast

articles.summary: Law.com reports that Travis Lenkner has returned to Burford Capital with "an eye on future growth opportunities." In an interview featuring CEO Christopher Bogart and Travis Lenkner, Burford has announced Lenkner's new role of Chief Development Officer, where he will be "...focused on strategic initiatives for Burford such as potential investments in law firm equity, legal technology, including artificial intelligence, and the alternative delivery of legal services."
articles.title: Law.com reports on Travis Lenkner's return to Burford Capital with "an Eye on Future Growth Opportunities"
